en: Psalms 50
A Psalm by Asaph.

p.src: 1  The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

en: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
u.src: 1  The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

p.src: 2  Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

ja: の極みであるシオンから、
en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
u.src: 2  Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

p.src: 3  Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

ja: られ、黙っておられない。
en: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
u.src: 3  Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

p.src: 4  He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

en: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
u.src: 4  He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

p.src: 5  “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

ja: めよ。 いけにえによって私と
en: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
u.src: 5  “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

p.src: 6  The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

ja: だからである。 セラ。
en: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
u.src: 6  The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

p.src: 7  “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

ja: る。 イスラエルよ、私はあなたに対して証言する。 私は
en: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
u.src: 7  “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

p.src: 8  I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

ja: 私は、あなたのいけにえのことであなたを
めるのではない。 あなたの
en: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
u.src: 8  I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

p.src: 9  I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

ja: 私はあなたの牛舎から
る必要も、 あなたの
en: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
u.src: 9  I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

p.src: 10  For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

ja: は私のものだからだ。 千の丘の家畜も。
en: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
u.src: 10  For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

p.src: 11  I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

en: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
u.src: 11  I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

p.src: 12  If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

ja: えていても、あなたには言わない。
ちているものは私のものだからだ。
en: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
u.src: 12  If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

p.src: 13  Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

en: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
u.src: 13  Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

p.src: 14  Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

ja: のいけにえをささげよ。 いと
en: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
u.src: 14  Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

p.src: 15  Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

ja: めよ。 私はあなたを助け
し、あなたは私をあがめる。」
en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
u.src: 15  Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

p.src: 16  But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

ja: われる。 「あなたに何の権利があって私の掟を
en: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
u.src: 16  But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

p.src: 17  since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

en: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
u.src: 17  since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

p.src: 18  When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

en: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
u.src: 18  When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

p.src: 19  “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

en: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
u.src: 19  “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

p.src: 20  You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

en: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
u.src: 20  You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

p.src: 21  You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

ja: あなたがこれらのことを
っていた。 あなたは、私が自分と全く
った。 私はあなたを
en: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
u.src: 21  You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

p.src: 22  “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

ja: えよ。 そうでなければ、私はあなたを
en: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
u.src: 22  “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

p.src: 23  Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

ja: のいけにえをささげる
en: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
u.src: 23  Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
